summary: Iteration 16 testing for new v2 features: Suppliers add/delete, Driver/Trailer registry, Arcade Chess tab, Manual v2 content, Promo video, Theme switcher (16 themes). Backend pytest: 10/10 passed. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Inconsistent POST /api/suppliers response shape — wraps payload as {ok, supplier:{...}} while POST /api/drivers and POST /api/trailers return the resource object directly. Recommend standardising envelope across CRUD endpoints.
Suppliers list endpoint returns `supplier_id` field rather than the generic `id` used by other resources (drivers/trailers). Consider aliasing to `id` for consistency or documenting per resource.

Promo video <video> element is muted by default with no visible 'unmute / play with sound' affordance — users may miss the new narration. Recommend adding an unmute hint/button or autoplaying muted then unmuting on first interaction.

Several 401 errors observed in browser console on initial dashboard load even with valid admin session — likely a non-critical race between cookie-set and a couple of early fetches; worth investigating for cleaner console.
test_credentials: Admin Bearer token test_session_admin_1 (cookie + header both work).
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed Supplier(s), Driver(s), Trailer(s); custom supplier auto-cleaned via DELETE in same test. Two TEST_Driver_<ts> rows remain in db.drivers (visible in /driver-registry) — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend POST /api/suppliers returns {ok, supplier:{supplier_id, ...}} — not flat. Trailers POST requires `trailer_no` (not unit_number/trailer_number). Manual v2.0 content endpoint /api/manual/content returns blob containing 'v2.0', 'copilot', 'power bi', 'sharepoint', 'specialty', 'driver', 'trailer', 'chess', 'theme', 'routing', 'promo'. /promo.mp4 is 5.0 MB h264+AAC 96.6s, served via CDN at content-type video/mp4. Theme switcher exposes 16 options via [data-testid=topbar-theme] (or button:has-text('HUD CYAN')).

Topbar theme switcher exposes 16 theme options

Sidebar entries nav-driver-registry and Specialty Carriers route correctly
